name: Phi-4-mini-instruct
notes: This is the record that makes the Phi family worth comparing: Phi-3 mini at 32 KV heads vs Phi-4 mini at 8 KV heads. head_dim derived = 3072 / 24 num_attention_heads = 128. kv_cache_bytes_per_token = num_layers * num_kv_heads * head_dim * 2 * 2 = 32 * 8 * 128 * 2 * 2 = 131072 bytes/token at bf16. Same hidden size and same layer count as Phi-3 mini, so weights are near-identical in size, but KV per token is 5.33x larger because head_dim doubled (96 -> 128) alongside the head reduction. A naive 'Phi-4 mini has GQA so it has less KV' claim is wrong: 131072 vs 24576 bytes/token. At 32k context that is 4.0 GiB of KV per sequence. other keys: partial_rotary_factor 0.75 (only 75% of head dims get RoPE), full_attn_mod 1, vocab 200064, tie_word_embeddings true (unlike Phi-3 mini), intermediate 8192, model_type still 'phi3'. Official ONNX (microsoft/Phi-4-mini-instruct-onnx) and wide GGUF ecosystem exist; litert-community port targets on-device Android.
